items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I have an older daughter, LaTonya.

ctx.x: I have an older daughter, LaTonya. Well the first one was Joe Jr., he’s the eldest. LaTonya, and then I had a son, Jeffrey, who passed away when he was twenty-one. And then another daughter, who lives down in Florida, Julia. And then Wayne.
Any of them follow the music business there, or go into music?
